max_similarity: Maximum cosine among valid Support items with rating>=.7
top2_similarity: Mean of largest2 (rating * cosine) contributions among all valid Support items, zero pad if fewer than2; requires at least one valid positive Support
weak_fallback: S missing or S<.05 -> exact original Hybrid H for that candidate; no valid positive Support -> H for whole user
blend: (1-lambda)*H + lambda*S, only when signal passes fixed floor; no fitted normalization
top50: Choose Top50 using H only, rerank strictly within those50; outside items cannot enter Top5
policies: Baseline lambda0 plus2 signals x3 lambda x2 scopes; fixed before any new results, no PN or additional search
selection: Mean fold positive-user NDCG then Recall then HitRate; strict improvement over Hybrid. Ties prefer smaller lambda, top50 then max, stable insertion last
final_artifact: Reuse verified V29 all50 developer item-only MF/Content/popularity state, apply selected V30 policy; no extra fit or service deployment
scope: Exact V26-29 developer50,5 folds40/10,Support5,candidates479,relevance.7. No reserved25 labels or V24 result reads; reused development CV, not independent final
